items.summary: The SARAS Melas organized under the Centre's DAY-NRLM connect rural women entrepreneurs with wider markets, buyers, and business opportunities. The Vijayawada edition marks the first National SARAS Mela outside Delhi-NCR , bringing together women entrepreneurs from 34 states and UTs.
